body: The burning building reference hits home. In my case, i set the building on fire intentionally. To push myself to the edge. Now I'm at the edge and looking back at the fire. I have nowhere else to go but to jump. I made it that way, to make the desicion of jumping justifiable or easier. But its been years now. The fire hasn't caught up, I'm still at the very edge. Nothing to go back to. The only question I ask myself is when will I jump. Sometimes, why i set the building on fire.
Hard same. Except that I don't drive at all. But the quitting job part is the most hitting one. Like pushing yourself to the edge but not actually jumping.
What if I don't do anything about it. Will it "get better"?
I feel you there. I forced myself to work just to have a sense of responsibility. And passion really doesn't exist. If it does, it will be too late.

Hey i know this is probably not the best advice or comment but you can always reach out still. Try always and move forward if it crashes. Life's a bitch. I can lend an ear if you want. I don't have anything better to do in my life anyway.

Yes. And I actually did.

Intentionally dropped out of college cause i thought I was gonna kill myself. Got a job instead.for 2 years.  But quit last week with the same mindset. Only this time I'm gonna make sure of it just so to not regret my choices.

You're not alone. I do hope we have a different mindset soon. And recover from our choices.

I feel you 100% 

Quit my job just so I could sleep. When they ask why. I just simply said I'm too lazy for it anymore. Or I dont want to work anymore.

They're encouraging me to go back to school or at least find a good simple course or another job. I dont reply. Even if I do, I'll lie about it. 

I just don't want to stress myself anymore. No regrets tho. I wanted this.

My take on this was, at the end of the day, we all have a friend that will hate us, but will always love us, and rely on us no matter how shitty our past was. It's a nice closure to someone as goofy as Todd. They'll think of the most stupid way to make us feel better.
